card.name: Multidrug resistance protein names
card.fires_on: The word "resistance" right after "multidrug" or "multi-drug", and the "rug" piece inside "multidrug", in transporter protein names such as MRP2 and P-gp.

modes.label: Resistance after multidrug
modes.description: The word resistance directly following multidrug in transporter names or in reversing drug resistance.

modes.label: Inside multidrug
modes.description: The "rug" piece in the word multidrug, before resistance, efflux or chemotherapy.
